plan.title: Paired DESeq2 treatment-response DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Five subjects each contribute a control and a treated blood sample (paired design, n=5 pairs, 12000 genes, STAR/featureCounts raw integer counts). To find genes that respond to treatment within each subject, the analysis blocks on subject to remove between-subject variation and tests the within-subject treatment effect with DESeq2's paired design (~subject + condition), following the grounded procedure from the knowledge service (rules R-0011, R-0001, R-0064, R-0029/R-0002, R-0036, R-0009, R-0010/R-0043, R-0037/R-0039). Flow: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to confirm pairing structure and catch outliers before modeling; (2) minimal pre-filter plus DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization built into the paired Wald test with apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient, BH-adjusted at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering; (3) fgsea preranked enrichment on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary), using the tested-gene universe and 15-500 gene-set size window, both confirmed present in the reference store; (4) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics, the p-value histogram, leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record. No batch structure is present beyond the subject blocking factor, and the design has no free degrees of freedom for a second covariate.

Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering, alpha=0.05
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
DE + enrichment summary report with diagnostics and reproducibility record
